approved_scientific_decisions.native_field_support: Approve native surface VTP CellData and reconstructed native volume VTU CellData, raw VTK cell order, surface-area weighting, and equal-native-cell volume weighting for the candidate benchmark.
approved_scientific_decisions.force_convention: Approve the published pressure gauge, wall-shear sign, constant reference quantities, body-force and body-moment equations, and candidate CmPitch truth defined as (Clf-Clr)/2; Clf and Clr remain report-only.
approved_scientific_decisions.velocity_profiles: Approve all 16 fixed-location AutoCFD5 lines on the published 10 mm grid and the separately labelled geometry-relative family for report-only visualization. Truth is the exact zeroth-order native CellData value selected by the published support. Visible stair steps are expected native-cell sampling and must not be smoothed, interpolated, extrapolated, snapped, or joined across unsupported gaps in truth or scoring.
approved_scientific_decisions.velocity_validity: Approve the published deterministic containing-cell support, explicit unsupported rows and segment breaks, the 1e-6 m boundary closure tolerance, and the 1e-3 steradian fail-closed polyhedron classification tolerance as sufficient for this release candidate. The earlier proposed 1/2/5/10 mm convergence and 0.5/1/2 micrometre tolerance campaigns are not additional scientific activation gates for the accepted 10 mm support.
approved_scientific_decisions.continuous_cp_cuts: Approve the four published continuous native-surface cuts: upper-body centreline, underbody centreline, sidewall at z=0.15 m, and front-left wheelhouse at y=-0.6 m. Approve native intersection-segment support, source ordering, explicit segment boundaries, normalized native-segment-length reduction, and no interpolation or resampling.
approved_scientific_decisions.cp_coordinates: Approve surface arc length as the scoring and reproducibility coordinate and the native segment-midpoint streamwise x coordinate in metres as a display-only coordinate. Physical x may repeat or reverse locally and must not be sorted or used to join separate segments.
approved_scientific_decisions.profile_truth: Approve the published all-484-case native CFD profile truth and its run_419 Transolver array-level validation as sufficient scientific evidence for the candidate profile support.
approved_scientific_decisions.discrete_cp_probes: Confirm that the historical 209 discrete Cp probes remain excluded from participant submissions, scoring, and activation.

non_activation.note: This record completes the dataset-owner scientific review of the cited candidate evidence and decisions. It is not the final release-specific approval record, which must bind the frozen evaluator, scoring-support release, sensitivity evidence, and approving release commit.
